Only in Kumarbi myth fragment with the storm god as king of all mankind (CTH 346.16): A speaker asks where silver and gold come from and whence they are, with divine statues mentioned; The storm god is called king of all mankind, with his heroism and valour praised; A speaker rebukes others: why do you kneel (bow down) before him?.

Only in Sincerity, daybreak and mankind: God's unity and the two refuges: Refuge from the evil of darkness (or the moon) when it settles (ghasiq idha waqab); Refuge from the evil of an envier when he envies (evil eye); God is al-Samad (the Eternal Refuge, the solid one who needs nothing); Triple title: Lord of mankind, King of mankind, God of mankind; Refuge from the evil of the slinking whisperer (al-waswas al-khannas) who whispers in people's breasts, from jinn and humans; Calling on a divine name or seeking refuge with God protects a person in the dark of night; God does not beget and was not begotten [contrast between the texts]; Protection against beings or evil of the night, invoked with the coming of dawn; Protective formula 'Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of...' matches.note: Ša-zi-ga: šīpāti peṣâti šīpāti sāmāti taṭawwi ... 7 u 7 kiṣrī tarakkas ... šiptu ina muhhi (you spin white and red wool, tie seven and seven knots, [recite] the incantation over it); 113:4: wa-min sharri n-naffāthāti fī l-ʿuqad. matches.label: Protective formula 'Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of...' (qul a'udhu bi-rabbi) against named evils
matches.note: aʿūdhu bi-rabbi l-falaq min sharri mā khalaq ~ YHWH yišmorkā mi-kkol rāʿ yišmōr ʾet nafšekā: God guards from every evil. The Quran puts it in the first person as a formula to be said (qul aʿūdhu).

passages.text: (121:1) שִׁ֗יר לַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֣א עֵ֭ינַי אֶל הֶהָרִ֑ים מֵ֝אַ֗יִן יָבֹ֥א עֶזְרִֽי (121:2) עֶ֭זְרִי מֵעִ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ (121:3) אַל יִתֵּ֣ן לַמּ֣וֹט רַגְלֶ֑ךָ אַל יָ֝נ֗וּם שֹֽׁמְרֶֽךָ (121:4) הִנֵּ֣ה לֹֽא יָ֭נוּם וְלֹ֣א יִישָׁ֑ן שׁ֝וֹמֵ֗ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל (121:5) יְהוָ֥ה שֹׁמְרֶ֑ךָ יְהוָ֥ה צִ֝לְּךָ֗ עַל יַ֥ד יְמִינֶֽךָ (121:6) יוֹמָ֗ם הַשֶּׁ֥מֶשׁ לֹֽא יַכֶּ֗כָּה וְיָרֵ֥חַ בַּלָּֽיְלָה (121:7) יְֽהוָ֗ה יִשְׁמָרְךָ֥ מִכָּל רָ֑ע יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת נַפְשֶֽׁךָ (121:8) יְֽהוָ֗ה יִשְׁמָר צֵאתְךָ֥ וּבוֹאֶ֑ךָ מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד עוֹלָֽם
